Notes: Signup terminals on playfield 6007. The NPC name is the bracket key in BattleStations.json. {bsqueue} spends 1 loyalty and joins that bracket.

hello.Text: Battle station signup. Teams are Red and Blue, assigned at random, and your faction does not matter. Signing up spends 1 loyalty. You start at 10. Finishing a match returns 2, up to 10. At 0 this terminal will not take you.
